How Dr. Stolz can help

Care for the whole person

Every session is one-on-one with Dr. Stolz, not a rotating team. Here are the areas she works in most.

01

Anxiety & stress

Worry that won't switch off, panic, tension, sleepless nights and stress from work, family or big life changes.

02

Depression & mood

Low mood, loss of interest, grief and the heaviness that makes everyday life harder than it should be.

03

ADHD support

Practical help with focus, organization, follow-through and the frustration that often comes with ADHD.

04

Addiction & gambling counseling

Counseling for substance-related concerns and problem gambling, an area Dr. Stolz has studied in depth.

05

Forensic & court evaluations

Psychological evaluations for legal and court matters, written with care, clarity and professional objectivity.

06

Integrative & mind-body therapy

Traditional talk therapy that can include meditation, music, art and animal-assisted elements when they help.

See all services

Her approach

Down to earth, and never rushed

Dr. Stolz believes there are many healthy paths to feeling better. Alongside traditional talk therapy, she may bring in meditation, music, art or animal-assisted elements when they help a client reconnect and find calm.

  • One-on-one sessions in a private Staten Island office
  • Licensed in New York and New Jersey
  • Experience supporting service members and their families
  • Formal evaluations for legal and court matters
